title: Stan Lee, 1922-2018
content: Comics writer and editor Stan Lee died today at age 95. He was best known for co-creating many of the famous Marvel characters, and he appeared in cameos in most of the Marvel movies.I first became aware of him through his how-to bookHow To Draw Comics The Marvel Way. It is still one of the best books on drawing figures from imagination.In the closing chat at the end of the book, Lee says:"To be a great artist, you've got to draw! Draw! Draw! Wherever you go, whatever you do, whenever you have a spare minute—draw! Sketch everything you see around you; sketch your friends, your enemies, relatives, strangers, anyone and everyone. Become as facile with a pencil, pen, or brush as you are with a knife and fork. The more you draw, the better you'll be. And we want you to be—the best! Excelsior!"----How To Draw Comics The Marvel WayStan Lee on Wikipedia
